teaser: Odoo's agents can write to the system of record. Our stack fits every Odoo from 12 to 20: a proof of concept ran on four versions in under a minute each.
core_idea: Odoo's agents now execute in the system of record; behaviour policies, signed approvals and a lasting record in a vault are what an Odoo business needs around them.

quotes.text: In other words, agents now execute in the system of record, on their own schedule.
That also answers the 30-day problem: the conversation can expire; the record does not.
We are the governance layer around them, not a rival agent.
So the newest features are a bonus, not a requirement.
